role: Junior Business Analyst, and a licensed Mechanical Engineer
summary: I work as a Junior Business Analyst at AvePoint Cebu. I came to it from mechanical engineering: I graduated from the University of San Carlos in 2024 and passed the licensure examination in February 2025, with hands-on training in maintenance engineering, mechanical drafting, and mechatronics servicing. The engineering habit of taking a system apart to understand how it behaves is the part I use most in analysis work.

timeline.detail: Promoted from Technical Intern in November 2025.
Joined AvePoint as a Technical Intern in May 2025 and was promoted to Junior Business Analyst six months later.
Interned with the Flour Mill Maintenance Engineering Department, working alongside the maintenance team on the mill's mechanical equipment.

timeline.org: University of San Carlos, Cebu City
timeline.detail: My thesis was the design and fabrication of a pyrolysis reactor recovering energy from cloth contaminated with used engine oil, which we presented at the 12th International Mechanical Engineering Research Conference in January 2024, having attended the 11th as a participant the year before.

timeline.org: University of San Carlos, Cebu City
timeline.detail: Completed senior high school at the University of San Carlos before continuing to the engineering programme.
